nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf holding token balances for glitchfinance.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used for ERC20 approvals.
Constant decimals = 18 exposed publicly.
Public totalSupply of the token.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Private owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor.
Private hardcoded privileged address owner2.
Private hardcoded privileged address owner3.
Private hardcoded privileged address owner4.
Private hardcoded privileged address owner5.
Private hardcoded privileged address owner6.
Constant internal UNI router address 0x7a25...488D.
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) guarded by ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) that delegates execution to an arbitrary address after a six-owner check.
Public payable batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) performing unchecked multiplication and balance updates in a loop.
Internal pure pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB) computing a Uniswap pair address from an init code hash.
Modifier ensure(address _from, address _to) that derives the UNI pair and restricts transfers to the six hardcoded owners or that pair.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owners, balances and unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used across transfer, transferFrom, approve, delegate, batchSend and constructor.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes attacker-supplied calldata in this contract's storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath overflow checking.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath overflow checking.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath overflow checking.
uint total = _value * _tos.length multiplication without overflow protection.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total executed without SafeMath overflow checking.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop without SafeMath overflow checking.
